Name: Silhy's HD AGE Portraits
Author: SilhyGames
Description:
I'm not much of a modder, myself, but while using a combination of HD Portrait packs by Jier, Beornwahl, Vile, and SuperSony2689, I noticed that Adventurer's Guild Expanded was kind of the odd mod out, and didn't have anything similar. So, I gave it my best shot to make some portraits that fit the aesthetic that those packs provide.

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/gu1fdy.png[/img]

[size=3]Make sure you have the following mods installed in advance:

[size=3]1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]
3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - StardewModding API[/url][/size][/size]

[size=3]After that, download the main file, and copy the unzipped folder named "Silhy's HD AGE Portraits" to your Mods folder. In-game, use Portraiture to swap to the portraits while talking to any Adventurer's Guild Expanded NPC.
[size=3]

Furthermore, this was made in the same style and vein as previous HD Portrait packs, so I recommend using it with any of the following:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14150]Jier's HD Portraits for SDV[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14441]Jier's HD Portraits for SVE[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14634]Vile's HD Bachelorette Portraits[/url]
[/size][/size]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15199]Beornwahl's Anime HD Portraits
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15512]Beornwahl's Anime HD SVE Portraits
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15671]SuperSony2689's HD Anime Ridgeside Village Portraits

[/url]

Downloads.Description: Includes portraits for Gabriel, Zinnia, Silly, Daisy, and Daniel, as well as beach versions for Gabriel, Zinnia, and Silly. You can enable or disable portraits with the mod config.
